I’ve never written a bad review in my life, but my recent experience with Coinbase has left me no choice. Over the past two days, I’ve spent a total of four hours on the phone with their customer support, and their incompetence and inflexible processes left me in tears.

Here is what happened:

	1.	Account inaccessible: I recently could not login to my Coinbase account because my two-step verification was linked to an old phone number I no longer have access to. Since I hadn’t updated my number, I couldn’t log in.
	2.	Failed ID Verification: To recover my account, I was asked to verify my ID. I followed the instructions, but the verification failed. The issue? I created my account 17 years ago with a French address, but my current passport shows my UK address. This mismatch caused the system to reject my verification.
	3.	First Call to Support (1.5 Hours): I called customer support to explain the situation. They told me to redo the ID verification. However, when it came time to record the video during the verification process, I couldn’t proceed because I was still on the phone with them. They advised me to hang up, complete the process, and assured me they would call me back to validate my ID manually. They never called me back.
	4.	Second Call to Support (2 Hours): The next day, I called again and had to explain everything all over to a new representative. After another two hours on the phone, my ID was finally validated by an “expert.” But then, the representative forgot the reason I had called in the first place—to update my phone number. She told me the only solution was to create a new account and transfer my funds.
	5.	New Account Creation Issues: I followed their instructions to create a new account, but I encountered yet another issue. My phone app kept switching between the browser and app in a continuous loop, making it impossible to complete the setup. The representative said she couldn’t see the new account on her end, so I had to delete it and try again from my computer.

After four hours of back-and-forth with no resolution, I felt completely defeated. I broke down in tears, overwhelmed by the sheer frustration and the lack of support. Coinbase’s processes are rigid and unforgiving, their system is plagued with technical issues, and their customer support—while polite—is not equipped to handle complex cases.

Coinbase, this experience was unacceptable. For a company that handles people’s money and sensitive information, your processes need to be efficient and customer-centric. You have deeply disappointed me, and I hope no one else has to endure what I’ve been through.
